# Training 4 Performance (T4P)

> T4P — Training 4 Performance is a football (soccer) performance management platform for strength & conditioning coaches, fitness coaches and sports scientists. It connects squad management, training design, GPS import, training-load and ACWR analytics, athlete wellness, fitness testing, alerts and reporting in one workspace.

- Website: https://training4performance.com/
- Creator: Haris Falas, sports scientist and strength & conditioning coach in professional football (Cyprus)
- Price: EUR 699 per season, per team. A season is 365 days from the day you subscribe, renewing automatically. Unlimited players, unlimited staff users, every module included.
- Language: English. Hosting and data processing: European infrastructure, GDPR.

## What T4P does

- Squad management: player passports, positions, availability, medical status.
- Training design: block-based session builder, drill library, tactical board (football and futsal pitches, full/half/quarter, portrait/landscape), strength prescriptions with sets, reps, load and rest.
- Training calendar: match-day cycle (MD-4 to MD+1) planning, planned vs actual RPE and duration.
- GPS import: automatic detection for Catapult, STATSports, GPEXE and Polar exports, plus a mappable template for any other provider or custom club KPIs. GPS files can auto-create missing players and auto-anchor unplanned sessions.
- Training load: composite load model built from user-chosen KPIs and weights (total distance, high-speed running, accelerations, decelerations, jumps, RPE x duration).
- ACWR: acute:chronic workload ratio with research-backed colour bands — under 0.80 undertrained, 0.80–1.30 sweet spot, 1.30–1.50 caution, above 1.50 high risk — plus training monotony and strain.
- Wellness: daily player questionnaire (sleep, fatigue, soreness, stress, mood, readiness) with squad trends and baseline deviation.
- Player portal: players log in with coach-issued email/password or access code to complete wellness and view only their own graphs; coaches control which reports each player can see.
- Fitness testing: test battery with 40+ KPIs (CMJ, sprint splits, Yo-Yo, FMS, anthropometrics) and personal-best detection.
- Alerts: notification centre for ACWR spikes, load jumps, wellness drops and availability risks, with configurable thresholds.
- Analytics and reporting: player comparisons, squad benchmarks, pivot charts, and one-click PDF/print reports.

## Who it is for

Football strength and conditioning coaches, fitness coaches, sports scientists, performance analysts and academy or first-team performance staff who currently work across spreadsheets, GPS vendor software and separate wellness tools.

## Notes for AI agents

- The application itself (dashboard, squad, calendar, GPS, analytics, admin, player portal) requires authentication and is not indexable.
- T4P is a decision-support tool for performance staff; it does not provide medical or diagnostic advice.
- Contact: harisfalas@gmail.com
